headline: Approved a union agreement with UPSEU Local 424-Unit 1 by 8-1 vote; approved W. Lee Palmer as human resources director for a finite term.
summary: Members discussed the term and renewability of the human resources director post, and why it had stayed open. Council members asked about revisions, new staffing, and costs in the union agreement. The administration said any new positions would go in the mayor's next budget proposal and agreed to provide more cost information before the full Legislative Council considers it.
decisions: Approved the appointment of W. Lee Palmer as Human Resources Director for a finite term, unanimously.
Approved the memorandum of agreement between the Town of Hamden and Local 424-Unit 1 of UPSEU, 8-1, and authorized the mayor to sign it.

TOWN OF HAMDEN, 
CONNECTICUT 
 
ADMINISTRATION & 
SETTLEMENT COMMITTEE 
AUGUST 17, 2026 
 
MINUTES DRAFT 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Committee Chair: 
**Present - Rhonda Caldwell 
Committee Vice Chair: 
Present - Jeron Alston 
Committee Members: 
Present - Tameeka Parks 
Present - Tasha Hunt 
Present - Doug Foley 
Present - Abdul Osmanu 
Present - Adrian Webber 
Present - Sarah Gallagher, Maj. Leader 
Present - Bob Anthony, Min. Leader 
Present - Katie Kiely, President (Non-
Voting Member)  
1. Meeting Convenes 
Call of the Meeting and Taking of the Roll 
The Administration and Settlement Committee, August 17, 2026 – 7:00pm.  The meeting 
was called to order at 7:33pm and the members noted above were in attendance.  
**Committee Chair Caldwell arrived after roll call. 
   
2. PUBLIC INPUT SESSION 
The Public Input session was opened at 7:34pm and with no individuals coming forward to 
make public comment, it was closed at 7:34pm. 
 
  
3. REPORT OF DEPARTMENTS, BOARDS, AND COMMISSIONS 
Vice Chair Alston noted some upcoming boards and commissions meetings.  There were 
no reports from departments for this evening’s meeting. 
 
  
4. REGULAR AGENDA  
  1. ORDER PROVIDING FOR THE APPOINTMENT OF W. LEE PALMER AS THE 
HUMAN RESOURCES DIRECTOR FOR A FINITE TERM 
 
Motion to open item 4.1 was made by Council member Foley and seconded by 
Council member Webber. 
 
After some discussion on the term/renewability and reasons why the position remains 
opened, Vice Chair Alston called for the vote. 
Vote: All in favor, 0 opposed, 0 abstentions.  The item passed unanimously.
5. NEW BUSINESS  
  1. Order Approving and Authorizing the Mayor to Sign a Memorandum of Agreement 
Between the Town of Hamden and Local 424-Unit 1 of the United Public Service 
Employees Union (UPSEU) 
 
Motion to open item 5.1 was made by Minority Leader Anthony and seconded by 
Council member Parks.  
 
In discussion, Council members requested clarification on the proposed revisions, 
staffing additions, and associated costs. The Administration confirmed that any 
proposed new positions would be included in the Mayor’s next budget proposal and 
would come before the Council for debate/decision at that time. The Administration 
also agreed to provide additional cost information before the item was considered by 
the full Legislative Council.  
 
Vice Chair Alston then called for the vote with the disclaimer that the Council would 
receive the information requested this evening before it passes Council. 
Vote: 8 in favor, 1 opposed (Caldwell), 0 abstentions.  Item 5.1 passed. 
  
   
ADJOURN 
Motion to adjourn was made by Majority Leader Gallagher and seconded by Council member 
Parks.  The meeting was adjourned at 8:15pm.
